acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given my financial data with a flexi facility, when I calculate the Velocity Banking Strategy, then it models income deposited directly to the flexi facility (reducing flexi balance on payday).
The strategy models all expenses paid from the flexi facility throughout the month, with the net effect being (income - expenses) reducing the average daily flexi balance.
Periodic chunks are transferred from the flexi facility to the target debt (highest interest rate first), following the avalanche targeting logic.
The projection shows month-by-month flexi balance fluctuation, capturing the "income parking" effect where money spends more time in the lower-rate flexi versus higher-rate debt accounts.
Flexi interest is calculated using daily compounding formula (balance * rate / 365 * days), benefiting from the lower average daily balance throughout the month.
Given no flexi facility exists in the financial snapshot, when velocity banking is calculated, then it returns null (not an error, just not applicable) with requiresFlexi = true.
The strategy has effort level = 'high' (requires active management, all money flow through flexi).

The strategy returns a StrategyProjection with all required fields: strategyId ('velocity-banking'), strategyName ('Velocity Banking'), effortLevel ('high'), debtFreeMonth, debtFreeDate, totalInterestPaid, totalPrincipalPaid, monthsSaved, interestSaved, monthlyProjections[].
The strategy implements the DebtStrategy interface with calculate() and allocatePayment() methods, following the Strategy Pattern (ADR-004).
All calculations use big.js for precision with cent-level accuracy (2 decimal places in ZAR).
Unit tests verify that velocity banking performs better than flexi chunking strategies when the rate differential is favorable and surplus is consistent.

interface.name: DebtStrategy
interface.signature: interface DebtStrategy { id: string; name: string; description: string; effortLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'; requiresFlexi: boolean; calculate(snapshot: FinancialSnapshot, config?: StrategyConfig, baseline?: StrategyProjection): StrategyProjection | null; allocatePayment(surplus: Big, accounts: SimulatedAccount[], flexi: SimulatedFlexi | null): PaymentAllocation[]; }

interface.name: StrategyProjection
interface.signature: interface StrategyProjection { strategyId: string; strategyName: string; effortLevel: EffortLevel; debtFreeMonth: number; debtFreeDate: string; totalInterestPaid: Big; totalPrincipalPaid: Big; monthsSaved: number; interestSaved: Big; monthlyProjections: MonthlyProjection[]; }

interface.name: generateProjection
interface.signature: function generateProjection(snapshot: FinancialSnapshot, allocator: PaymentAllocator, config?: ProjectionConfig): MonthlyProjection[]

interface.name: buildStrategyProjection
interface.signature: function buildStrategyProjection(strategy: DebtStrategy, projections: MonthlyProjection[], startDate: string, baseline?: StrategyProjection): StrategyProjection

tests.standards: Tests use Vitest with describe/it/expect patterns. Tests are co-located in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure. Use Big.js for all monetary assertions. Test coverage targets: 90% line coverage for calculations, 80% branch coverage for strategies. All tests must pass before story completion.
